Name: Student Activities Management System (SAMS) Project
Notes: Project starts on 18 July 2026. Phase 1 deadline: 26 July 2026 at 23:59. Phase 2 final deadline: 9 August 2026 at 23:59.

Name: Phase 1 — Initial Study and Mid-Project Progress Report
Notes: Initial study, requirements identification, task distribution, project organization, Gantt chart preparation, and Phase 1 submission.

Name: Initial Project Study and Scenario Review
Notes: Review the SAMS scenario, identify the main problem, objectives, users, and system scope.

Name: Identify and Organize System Requirements
Notes: Identify student, organizer, Student Affairs, and automatic system requirements.

Name: Distribute Responsibilities and Organize Project Work
Resource Names: Lana Ayman Abu Habib; Khawla Lami
Notes: Assign member responsibilities, organize files, and prepare the Phase 1 report structure.

Name: Task 1 — Develop the Project Gantt Chart
Notes: Develop the Gantt chart with major activities, durations, resources, and dependencies.

Name: Phase 1 Submission — 26/07/2026 at 23:59
Notes: Submit the Mid-Project Progress Report in Word and PDF formats by 26 July 2026 at 23:59.

Name: Phase 2 — Analysis and Design Deliverables
Notes: Complete Tasks 2–7, integrate the report, review all deliverables, and submit the final report.

Name: Task 2 — Evolutionary Prototyping and Three Low-Fidelity Screens
Notes: Justify evolutionary prototyping and prepare three low-fidelity prototype screens.

Name: Task 3 — Context Diagram and Level-0 DFD
Notes: Identify external entities, major processes, data flows, and data stores.

Name: Task 3 — Three Level-1 DFDs
Notes: Develop three Level-1 DFDs for three major processes and maintain balancing.

Name: Task 4 — Use Case Model and Three Documented Use Cases
Notes: Identify all actors, prepare the complete Use Case Diagram, and document three use cases.

Name: Task 5 — Two UML Activity Diagrams
Notes: Develop two UML Activity Diagrams for two major business processes.

Name: Task 6 — UML Class Diagram
Notes: Define classes, attributes, methods, associations, multiplicities, and inheritance.

Name: Task 7 — Relational Database Design and 3NF
Notes: Design tables, data types, primary keys, foreign keys, relationships, and normalization up to 3NF.

Name: Integrate, Review, and Format the Final Project Report
Resource Names: Lana Ayman Abu Habib; All Members
Notes: Combine all project sections, review consistency, complete reflections, and prepare Word and PDF files.

Name: Phase 2 Final Submission — 09/08/2026 at 23:59
Notes: Submit the Final Project Report in Word and PDF formats by 9 August 2026 at 23:59.
